value.text: 人気ホラーアドベンチャーの最新作 PS2版『SILENT HILL 4 THE ROOM』6月17日（木）

March 03, 2004 - Silent Hill 4: The Room will arrive for the Japanese PS2 on 6/17 at the price of 6980 yen. The Xbox version of the game has yet to be announced for a similar release. Development, on the PS2 version at least, has been listed at 98% by the company.
Silent Hill 4: The Room will see release in Japan for PS2 […] on June 17[, 2004], Famitsu Weekly reports this week.

Konami vient de dévoiler la date de sortie nipponne de son jeu Silent Hill 4 sur PlayStation 2 […]. C'est le 17 juin [2004] que ce nouveau survival horror débarquera dans les boutiques japonaises au prix de 6.980 yens, soit environ 52€.

REDWOOD CITY, CALIF. - September 7, 2004 - Konami Digital Entertainment - America, a division of Konami Digital Entertainment, Inc., today announced that Silent Hill 4: The Room™ for the PlayStation® 2 computer entertainment system, the Xbox® video game system from Microsoft and PC DVD-ROM has shipped to retail stores nationwide.

Posted: Sep 7, 2004 11:50 pm - Konami has announced that Silent Hill 4: The Room, the latest title in the company's signature survival-horror franchise, has shipped for the PlayStation 2, Xbox, and PC.

[…] September 7, 2004 […] Weeks after it debuted at the top of the Japanese charts, Silent Hill 4: The Room is poised to scare American gamers senseless. Konami announced this morning that the game has shipped for the PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 2. Rated "M" for Mature, the self-developed sequel retails for $39.99; the PC version will ship on a DVD-ROM.
